work.author: Augustine of Hippo
work.description: Augustine's sermon on the appointed Gospel of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost, Luke 7:11-16, which reads the three raisings the Gospels record as three grades of sin: the girl raised inside the house, the young man carried out of the gate, and Lazarus four days buried. Modern sermon numbering calls it Sermo 98; the older English New Testament series calls the same work Sermon 48. A locus is 98 followed by the section number.
work.title: Sermo XCVIII
